question: To whom may this Kaula teaching be transmitted and to whom must it be denied?
premises: This Kaula teaching should be given to the worthy.
It should not be given indiscriminately.
Transmission is restricted to qualified recipients.
inference: This Kaula teaching must be given only to the worthy and withheld from just anyone.
plain_english: This Kaula teaching should be given to the worthy, but it must not be given to just anyone.
